description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class in an Android application that uses MediaCodec API to decode and render video frames onto a TextureView. It manages media extraction, decoding, and rendering, and includes UI interactions to control playback.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling video playback using MediaCodec and TextureView, managing media extraction and rendering lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and references UI components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for playback control.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases media resources and stops animations when activity is paused.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, starting playback when 'play' is selected.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Sets up MediaExtractor, accesses the video track, initializes MediaCodecWrapper, and starts synchronized video playback using TimeAnimator.
